difficulty.note: PowerPyx and KeenGamer both rate the platinum 4/10. No multiplayer trophy exists, nothing is missable except possibly one meditation, and there is no mission replay or difficulty trophy.

disagreements.verdict: Both are estimates; KeenGamer also says ~200h. Plan for 200h, allow more if you go for full 100% of everything.
28 — the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) marks 28 as hidden, matching the four sources.

sideA.claim: UFO easter egg: road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, alone, blinking car, follow into the woods

disagreements.topic: The Truth Is Out There — UFO method
disagreements.verdict: PowerPyx gives a concrete, testable method; KeenGamer has not confirmed it. Follow PowerPyx and expect some spawn randomness.

sideA.claim: Kick 10 pedestrians with Square from a bike within 60 seconds

disagreements.verdict: PowerPyx gives a concrete method; KeenGamer has not confirmed it. The description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') matches the bike-kick method.

sideA.claim: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it beside the bar

disagreements.topic: In The Beginning… — Apple Martini trigger
disagreements.verdict: PowerPyx gives a concrete method; KeenGamer has not confirmed it. The description ('Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach') matches.

sideA.claim: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom (needs Key Cloner) and drive it through the window

disagreements.verdict: PowerPyx gives a concrete method; KeenGamer has not confirmed it. The description ('Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style') matches.

items: Complete all story missions — 13 story trophies (Chapters 1-5, final mission) pop automatically and cannot be missed.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot at Jason's house after the mission Down to Earth (the only possibly missable trophy — see Positive Mental Attitude).
Try all 9 activity types once (Master of None), play an arcade game (Stick Fiddler), and scan vehicles and locations with WAiNK as you travel.
Do the optional questlines as they appear (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) — they all stay available after the story.
Keep 15 manual save slots in mind: there is no mission replay, so save before risky moments. Cheats disable trophies and saving.
roadmap.summary: Play through the story, enjoy the game, and knock out the easy trophies on the way.
roadmap.title: Play the story

items: 100 optional tasks (any of the 200-300+ optional missions).
All robberies: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults.
15 of 18 collectible card sets (480 cards), 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 14 Top Fun drone locations, 42 drone time trials, 30 of 40 races won.
Hardest trophy: A Long Road (100% completion). Nothing on the checklist is missable.
roadmap.summary: The long grind. Work the in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) — it unlocks the gold trophy A Long Road and is closer to 60% of everything in the game.
roadmap.title: The 100% checklist

items: Crime trophies: steal the plane (Catch Me If You Can), steal the tank (Challenging Tank), 5 enemies in one Combat Focus (Gunslinger), launder $250,000 (Dime on the Dollar).

Easter eggs and one-offs: the UFO (The Truth Is Out There), the Apple Martini (In The Beginning...), the blue Banshee showroom (Capital Offense), the bowling valuables (Let's Go Bowling), the bike kicks (Ten Pin).
Grind trophies: 500 Criminal Profile actions (Actions Speak Louder), spend $100,000 (Treat Yo Self), buy all 8 garages (Little Boxes), register 10 vehicles (On the Spot).
Check the tracker — the platinum pops with the last trophy.
